column1:
A Bastion convoy must cross a contested freight corridor.

1. Scout and clear three checkpoints with infantry and tanks.
2. Advance or hold the convoy; use repair robots on damaged trucks.
3. Each truck stops for 12 seconds at a clear checkpoint. Extract at least two.

Two truck losses mean defeat. Use Tactical pause to plan orders. No base building or programs are required.
column2:
一支堡垒车队必须穿越交战中的货运走廊。

1. 派步兵与坦克侦察并清理三个检查站。
2. 命令车队前进或停留，用维修机器人修复受损卡车。
3. 每辆卡车需在已清理的检查站停留 12 秒。至少撤离两辆。

损失两辆卡车即为失败。可用战术暂停规划指令，无需建造基地或编写程序。

column1: Completion gives First Orders +20 starting materials.
column2: 完成后，“初次指令”初始材料增加 20。

column1: Three finite, warned responses. Story / Standard / Veteran: 3 / 4 / 5 defenders per checkpoint, 2 / 3 / 4 reinforcements.
column2: 共三波增援，均有预警。剧情 / 标准 / 老兵：每个检查站 3 / 4 / 5 名守军，每波 2 / 3 / 4 个增援单位。

column1:
Helix is fragmenting the mountain uplink. Keep two fronts supplied while you reconnect it.

1. Capture any two of three relays with infantry.
2. Hold two uncontested relays for 120 cumulative seconds.
3. Split your armor and repair programs across separate assignments.

Your command lab and tank chips are ready. Direct orders always take priority.
Defeat: lose all forces and HQ, or fail to rebuild HQ within 60 seconds.
column2:
螺旋正在切断山区的上行链路。重新连接网络，同时维持两条战线的补给。

1. 用步兵占领三个中继站中的任意两个。
2. 无争夺地控制两个中继站，累计 120 秒。
3. 将装甲部队和维修程序分配到不同任务区域。

指挥实验室与坦克芯片已就绪，手动指令始终优先。
失败条件：失去全部部队与总部，或总部被毁后 60 秒内未能重建。

column1: Optional: hold all three relays for 20 cumulative seconds to earn Air Corridor support.\n
column2: 可选：同时控制全部三个中继站，累计 20 秒，即可获得“空中走廊”支援。\n

column1: This support removes the initial Wraith patrol in Air Corridor.
column2: 此支援将移除“空中走廊”中的初始幽灵巡逻队。

column1: Six warned responses from the northeast and southeast, starting after your first capture.
column2: 首次占领后，东北与东南方向将出现六波增援，均有预警。

column1:
Helix has cut access to a logistics relay. Restore your command network,
teach a support unit its assignment, and take the relay back.

1. Build a command lab.
2. Assign a retreat or repair program.
3. Capture the relay with infantry and hold for 60 uncontested seconds.

Defeat: lose all forces and HQ, or fail to rebuild HQ within 60 seconds.
Reinforcements begin after you secure the relay. No code or network required.
column2:
螺旋切断了一座后勤中继站。恢复指挥网络，
给支援单位指派任务，并夺回中继站。

1. 建造指挥实验室。
2. 配置撤退或维修程序。
3. 用步兵占领中继站，并无争夺地控制 60 秒。

失败条件：失去全部部队与总部，或总部被毁后 60 秒内未能重建。
占领中继站后敌军开始增援，无需编程或联网。

column1: Optional: save and reuse a changed retreat threshold to earn Adaptive doctrine.\n
column2: 可选：修改撤退阈值，保存并复用，即可获得“适应战术”徽章。\n

column1: The badge is cosmetic. Presets alone can complete the operation.
column2: 徽章仅作纪念，使用预设程序即可完成本次行动。

column1: Three objective-directed responses. Unit health and damage stay the same.
column2: 三波增援会向目标推进，单位生命值与伤害不变。

column1:
Open an evacuation corridor across the industrial quarry.

1. Ground troops destroy both anti-air batteries. Use the north or south bypass.
2. Position a ground screen east of the quarry; aircraft can fly directly across.
3. Launch and escort one evacuation flight at a time. Two flights must escape.

Helix Lancers threaten aircraft; your ground troops counter them. Walkers provide mobile anti-air. Stationary aircraft repair at the flight hangar.
Two flight losses or unrecovered HQ loss mean defeat. Presets or direct orders both work.
column2:
在工业采石场上空开辟撤离走廊。

1. 地面部队从南北侧绕行，摧毁两座防空炮台。
2. 在采石场东侧部署地面掩护；飞行单位可直接越过采石场。
3. 每次放飞并护送一架撤离运输机，至少让两架成功撤离。

螺旋枪骑兵威胁航空器，可用地面部队克制。步行机甲提供机动防空，飞行单位停在机库旁可维修。
损失两架运输机，或总部被毁且未及时重建，即为失败。可使用预设程序或手动指令。

column1: Optional: save all three flights to record +20 electronics for operation 05.\n
column2: 可选：保全三架运输机，为行动 05 获得额外 20 电子元件。\n

column1: Split Signal support: initial Wraith patrol removed.
column2: 分裂信号支援：初始幽灵巡逻队已移除。

column1: Split Signal's network badge removes the initial Wraith patrol.
column2: “分裂信号”的网络徽章可移除初始幽灵巡逻队。

column1: Each launch warns one finite ground/air response. Flights wait for your command.
column2: 每次起飞会触发一波有预警的地空增援，运输机等待你的命令。

column1: Story · 2 units per response
column2: 剧情 · 每波 2 个增援单位

column1: Standard · 3 units per response
column2: 标准 · 每波 3 个增援单位

column1:
Take the industrial works without losing your support force.

1. Destroy the north and south production nodes to cancel their unfinished units.
2. Scout around warehouses; infantry and armor take separate street approaches.
3. Infantry capture in 10 seconds, then secure 30 cumulative, uncontested seconds.

Protect repair robots. Repair channels do not stack; Guard areas bound pursuit.
Direct orders and presets both work. Rebuild a lost HQ within 60 seconds.
column2:
夺取工业设施，同时保护你的支援部队。

1. 摧毁南北生产节点，中止其未完成的单位。
2. 绕仓库侦察，步兵与装甲分路推进。
3. 步兵占领需 10 秒，之后无争夺控制累计 30 秒。

保护维修机器人；维修通道不叠加，警戒区域限制追击范围。
可使用手动指令或预设程序，总部被毁后须在 60 秒内重建。

column1: Completion unlocks an alternate approach in the finale.\n
column2: 完成后解锁最终行动的另一条进攻路线。\n

column1: Air Corridor support: +20 starting electronics.
column2: 空中走廊支援：初始电子元件增加 20。

column1: Saving all Air Corridor flights grants +20 starting electronics here.
column2: 保全“空中走廊”的所有运输机，可在此获得额外 20 初始电子元件。

column1: District entry starts three finite paid batches per node. Disabling both warns one final east response.
column2: 进入区域后，每个节点启动三批已支付的生产。摧毁两个节点后，东方将出现最后一波有预警增援。

column1: Story · 1 unit per batch
column2: 剧情 · 每批 1 个单位

column1: Standard · 2 units per batch
column2: 标准 · 每批 2 个单位

column1: Veteran · 3 units per batch
column2: 老兵 · 每批 3 个单位

column1:
Secure the forward deployment zone, then break Helix command.

1. Infantry capture the zone in 10s, then hold for 30 cumulative uncontested seconds.
2. Leave a guard and infantry at deployment while your mixed strike force destroys the HQ.

Reuse saved doctrines. Recapture lost deployment to finish; rebuild your HQ within 60s.
column2:
夺取前沿部署区，随后摧毁螺旋指挥部。

1. 用步兵在 10 秒内占领部署区，之后无争夺控制累计 30 秒。
2. 留下警戒部队与步兵，派混合突击队摧毁敌军总部。

可复用已保存的战术。若部署区失守，需夺回才能完成任务；总部被毁后须在 60 秒内重建。

column1: Broken Foundry support: the north ground passage is open.
column2: 破碎铸造厂支援：北侧地面通道已开放。

column1: Use the south ground pass. Broken Foundry completion opens a north passage.
column2: 可经南侧地面通道进攻。完成“破碎铸造厂”后可开放北侧通道。

column1: \nRequired troops, chips, Coordination and air support are available in every run.
column2: \n每次行动均提供必要的部队、芯片、协同科技与空中支援。
